state:
Goal `core-response-and-1-more`: `Core\Response::addCookie`, `bytes` and `html` have every feature
proof — `about.md`, three examples with `.nvsr` requests, the attack, the bench record in
`docs/perf/members.ndjson`, and a Rust `#[test]` carrying `covers:` in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`. The `BYTES_DOC` and `HTML_DOC` cards are rewritten to
AGENTS.md § *Text an end user reads*; the other `Core\Response` cards are not yet.
`Core\Response\Stream` is still in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in
`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, and `Core\Response\Stream::write` owes it. Nothing is blocked.

`nvs run --request` prints the response body alone, never the status line or the headers. A body
member's bench must write bodies with no newline in them: a newline flushes the terminal on every
call, and the figure then measures the flush (a `bytes` bench with a CSV body read ~1.1 µs/op, the
same bench without newlines ~110 ns/op).
